0022600019.text: Orlando is 1-2 on the season and 10th in the East, 1.5 games back in the Southeast, after a win in its last game, while Toronto is 2-1, 5th in the East, and 0.5 games back in the Atlantic after a loss. The Magic are missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and the Raptors are without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the Magic lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, and their most recent meeting, on March 29, 2026 in Toronto, ended 139-87 in Toronto's favor.
